title: IEEE1722: CF: Updated parts of the protocol to the newer 2025 version.
description:
- Extended dissect_1722_tscf() & dissect_1722_ntscf() to include version 1 headers.
- Extended dissect_1722_acf_can_common() to include ACF_CAN_V2 and ACF_CAN_BRIEF_V2.

IEEE 1722 specification has a newer 2025 version which defines new data formats and has also modified existing data formats. In this PR, I am taking the first steps to include the changes from the specification. The dissector remains a long way away from the specification, but the most important formats which will be in usage have been updated/included. Based on the acceptance, we will be making further contributions to this dissector.

I am happy to make changes based on the feedback from the maintainers.
